lines.beaver_en: You called me? Is it about my evaluation?
lines.learner: 네, 상반기 업무 태도 평가를 전하려고 해요.
lines.en: Yes, I want to share your first-half work attitude review.
lines.roman: Ne, sangbangi eommu taedo pyeongkkareul jeonharyeogo haeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Please go ahead. I'm a little nervous.
lines.en: Overall, I think you were faithful to your duties.

lines.beaver: 감사합니다. 더 말씀해 주실 점이 있습니까?
lines.beaver_en: Thank you. Is there anything else?
lines.beaver_roman: Gamsahamnida. Deo malsseumhae jusil jjeomi itseumnikka?
lines.en: You were proactive and took the lead in meetings.

lines.beaver: 태도와 의지에 대해 더 말씀해 주시겠습니까?
lines.beaver_en: Could you tell me more about my attitude and drive?
lines.beaver_roman: Taedowa uijie daehae deo malsseumhae jusigetseumnikka?
lines.en: You showed strong drive and were very proactive.

lines.beaver: 다른 의견은 없습니까? 부족한 점도 듣고 싶습니다.
lines.beaver_en: Anything else? I'd like to hear my weak points too.
lines.beaver_roman: Dareun uigyeoneun eopseumnikka? Bujokan jeomdo deutgo sipseumnida.
lines.learner: 가끔 성과를 뽐내는 듯 보여서 아쉬웠어요.
lines.en: Sometimes you seemed to show off your results.
lines.roman: Gakkeum seongkkwareul ppomnaeneun deut boyeoseo aswiwosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Oh, it looked that way. I'll fix it.
lines.learner: 말할 때 조금 더 신중하면 좋지 않을까 해요.
lines.en: I wonder if being a bit more prudent when speaking would help.
lines.roman: Malhal ttae jogeum deo sinjunghamyeon jochi aneulkka haeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Is there anything else I should watch out for?
lines.en: You should hold back from careless promises.

lines.beaver: 네, 일정을 너무 많이 잡았던 것 같습니다.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, I think I took on too many commitments.
lines.beaver_roman: Ne, iljjeongeul neomu mani jabatdeon geot gatseumnida.
lines.learner: 그래도 일 처리는 늘 깔끔해서 믿음이 가요.
lines.en: Still, your work is always neat, so I trust you.
lines.roman: Geuraedo il cheorineun neul kkalkkeumhaeseo mideumi gayo.

lines.beaver_en: Thank you so much for seeing it that way.
lines.learner: 창조적인 능력 계발에도 힘써 주길 바라요.
lines.en: I hope you'll also work on developing your creative skills.
lines.roman: Changjojeogin neungnyeok gyebaredo himsseo jugil barayo.

lines.beaver_en: I'll work harder. Thank you for your feedback.
lines.learner: 기대할게요. 이번 달 하순에 다시 이야기해요.
lines.en: I'm counting on you. Let's talk again late this month.
lines.roman: Gidaehalkkeyo. Ibeon dal hasune dasi iyagihaeyo.
